name: Nhagruul Dragonspawn

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Action Recovery
traits.details: Whenever the dragonspawn ends its turn, any dazing, stunning, or dominating effect on it ends.

traits.name: Instinctive Ferocity
traits.details: On an initiative of 10 + the dragonspawn’s initiative check, the dragonspawn can use bite or fiery spittle as a free action. If the dragonspawn cannot use a free action to make this attack due to a dominating or a stunning effect, then that effect ends instead of the dragonspawn making the attack.

hit.description: damage, and ongoing 10 poison damage (save ends).

effect.description: The dragonspawn uses bite against two different creatures.

powers.name: Frightful Roar
powers.description: The target chooses to either take a -2 penalty to attack rolls until the end of its next turn or take a free action to move its speed away from the dragonspawn.

hit.description: The target is dazed until the end of the dragonspawn’s next turn.

aftereffects.name: Aftereffect
aftereffects.description: The target chooses to either take a -2 penalty to attack rolls until the end of its next turn or take a free action to move its speed away from the dragonspawn.

miss.description: The target takes a -2 penalty to attack rolls until the end of the dragonspawn’s next turn.

powers.name: Wing Claw
powers.trigger: An enemy within 2 squares of the dragonspawn hits the dragonspawn with a melee attack.

effect.description: The dragonspawn flies up to 4 squares. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.
Breath weapon recharges, and the dragonspawn uses it.
